Title: Ishaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anjali - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Naira - 9 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress
4. Sharda - 69 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Ishaan stands in the park. Anjali and Sharda stand near him.]

Sharda: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Sharda: "Exactly right."

[Ishaan plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Ishaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
